name: rifle-gap-bias
description: Replication package of the paper 'Does a mayor improve a city beyond chance? Missing data at a change of mayor makes the test say yes': size of the RIFLE test (Berry and Fowler) with gaps in the middle of the series, measured in a translation of the official code on the real tenure structure of 5,468 Brazilian municipalities; anonymized panel, frozen outputs with sha256, tests that lock the published numbers and a Merkle provenance chain.

affiliation.name: Codex Hash Research Laboratory, Codex Hash Ltda., Brazil
